headline: MIN @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.76 at BOS 3.71, with a projected total of 7.47. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIN moved -0.82 runs while BOS moved -1.08, changing the projected margin by +0.26 runs. The projected total fell -1.89, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Connor Prielipp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ryan Jeffers, Ceddanne Rafaela, Kody Clemens, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
